target_customer: B2B sales teams and sales reps
problem: Sales reps drop follow-ups and personalizing outreach at scale is time consuming, so pipeline leaks.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for sales teams
product_category: AI sales assistant and email personalization

founders.name: Will Dinkel
founders.background_notes: A Forum Ventures Q&A with him exists but was not opened.

competitors.name: Clari
competitors.what: Pipeline and forecast intelligence for enterprise sales teams
competitors.traction_then: Said it served over 100 enterprise sales organizations

competitors.name: Salesforce Einstein
competitors.what: AI features inside Sales Cloud such as lead scoring and next best action
competitors.traction_then: Announced September 2016, many features not shipped until 2017

competitors.name: InsideSales
competitors.what: Playbooks sales acceleration with proactive suggestions
competitors.traction_then: Closed beta for four months before October 2016 launch

technical_complexity.rationale: Natural language personalization and next action models were demanding in 2016 but a small team could build a first version with available machine learning tools.

defensibility.rationale: Sales AI was copyable by larger CRM vendors, and personalized email generation had few barriers beyond data and integrations.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Salesforce announced Einstein in September 2016 covering similar next best action ideas; Nova was later acquired by Highspot in April 2020.

market_need_then: Sales teams were adopting sales automation tools and AI was being marketed in CRM in 2016; TechCrunch covered Nova's launch in February 2016 as AI powered lead personalization.

branding.domain_note: Held nova.ai, a premium AI domain; by 2026 nova.ai redirects to a domain marketplace page, so the domain is no longer the company's.

brand_strength.rationale: Common word name used by many unrelated companies (Nova Intelligence, Nova Labs, etc.). Little sourced press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Nova joined YC in Winter 2016 selling AI personalized email and next best action tools to sales reps, an area where Salesforce, Clari and InsideSales were all moving. It was acquired by Highspot in April 2020 at an undisclosed price, which suggests a small outcome rather than a breakout, but no source states the terms or the team's fate.
notes: Funding unverified: Bouncewatch lists 120K pre-seed (Mar 2016) and 1.7M seed (May 2016), with investors including Pegasus Tech Ventures and Fenox Venture Capital (Dealroom), totals 2.18M, CB Insights 1.92M, VCBacked 1.0M. Single aggregator figures, so not recorded as rounds. Competitor sources are dated Mar to Oct 2016, mostly after the batch, so treat them as adjacent contemporaries. Founding year 2015 (Dealroom) vs 2016 (CB Insights). Acquisition date rests on Dealroom and Village; no Highspot announcement was found. Company website nova.ai now redirects to a domain sale page. Completeness pass: the 120K pre-seed (2016-03) and 1.7M seed (2016-05) rest on Bouncewatch alone; only Pegasus Tech Ventures is named by both Bouncewatch and Dealroom (others differ: Salesforce Ventures and FoundersX, or Fenox). Bouncewatch totals 2.18M, so about 360K is unrecorded.
